name: mage-os/module-extension-directory-test-toolchain
description: Toolchain manifest for the hermetic unit suite. The module's own require block pulls magento/framework from repo.magento.com, which needs marketplace credentials; the unit suite runs against committed stubs instead, so it only needs PHPUnit. Installing this file puts PHPUnit into the repository's vendor/ directory, keeping `vendor/bin/phpunit` and `composer test` working from the repository root.
